description: Static analysis for .NET in three families: XamlQuality for XAML markup, AssemblyQuality for the compiled assembly, and CodeQuality, a Roslyn analyzer, for the source. Ships as Bennewitz.Ninja.XamlQuality, .XamlQuality.ThemeAudit, .XamlQuality.ThemeRuntime, .AssemblyQuality and .CodeQuality.

undocumented..claude-plugin: Holds only marketplace.json, the manifest Claude Code reads to serve the drivable-ui plugin in docs/ai-drivable-ui/plugin/. docs/AGENTS.md describes both.

XamlQuality.Trimming: It reads types and IL by reflection (ElementTypes, CompiledStrings), and the trim analyser reports 106 places, measured 2026-10-26. Not trimmable until plans/00008 side 2 makes it trim-clean (plans/00009 decision 19 in Bennewitz.Ninja.Templates).

XamlQuality.ThemeRuntime.Tests.ImplicitUsings: It compiles the runtime theme check's source files as an adopting project that turns implicit usings off would, so a file that leans on one fails here rather than in that project (plans/00003).
